capabilities: scan for new notes on startup and on an interval
suggest destination folders from keyword rules
propose new tags for confirmation before adding them
move notes, update internal links, and append a backlink block
rebuild an ASCII folder tree with live note counts
extras: Not yet in the community plugin store; install via BRAT (elowenMiMi/inbox-classifier) or manually. Works only on Markdown notes and uses keyword matching, so the rule file needs manual upkeep; the plugin stops rather than moving anything if the rule file is missing or invalid. The manifest description mentions scanning notes synced from the Get 笔记 app; the README itself only refers to new notes.
problem: Notes captured or synced into a vault pile up unfiled, and manually choosing folders and tags for each one is tedious.
summary: Rule-based inbox triage that scans for new notes, suggests a folder and tags, and files each note after user confirmation.
